tool.name: pmotools extract_info
tool.description: List and count specimens, samples, targets, and metadata from a PMO
tool.command: pmotools-python $info_mode.subcommand --file '$input_pmo' --output '$output_table' @OVERWRITE@ #if $info_mode.subcommand in ("list_library_sample_names_per_specimen_name", "list_specimen_meta_fields", "count_specimen_meta", "count_targets_per_library_sample", "count_library_samples_per_target"): --delim '$info_mode.delim' #end if #if $info_mode.subcommand == "count_specimen_meta": --meta_fields '$info_mode.meta_fields' #end if #if $info_mode.subcommand in ("count_targets_per_library_sample", "count_library_samples_per_target"): --read_count_minimum $info_mode.read_count_minimum #end if

param.name: subcommand
param.label: Info extraction mode
param.option: List library sample names per specimen name

param.name: read_count_minimum
param.label: Minimum read count
param.help: The minimum read count (inclusive) to be counted as covered by sample

param.name: read_count_minimum
param.label: Minimum read count
param.help: The minimum read count (inclusive) to be counted as covered by sample

tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Extract Basic Info from PMO**
Extracts basic information from a PMO file in tabular format:
- **List library sample names per specimen name**: Lists all library sample names associated with each specimen name. - **List specimen metadata fields**: Lists all metadata field names found in the specimen_info section. - **List bioinformatics run names**: Lists all bioinformatics run names in the PMO. - **Count specimen metadata values**: Counts the values of selected specimen metadata fields (e.g. collection_country, collection_date). - **Count targets per library sample**: Counts the number of targets detected per library sample, optionally filtered by a minimum read count. - **Count library samples per target**: Counts the number of library samples per target, optionally filtered by a minimum read count.
**Input**
- A PMO JSON file (optionally gzipped)
**Output**
- A tabular file with the requested information
